texts: The Week 4 Menu is up. Three starting quarterbacks and four lead backs are off the menu, and Jaylen Warren walks into the top 10 at running back Thursday night with Rico Dowdle on two straight missed practices. Start him. PPR, all tiers. Let's look into it. #HereWeGo

QB. Tier 1: Allen. Tier 2: Jackson, Lawrence, Hurts, Daniels (Q). Daniels practices in London in an elbow brace and stays at the bottom of the tier until he does. Start all five; keep a backup ready for Daniels. #BillsMafia #RavensFlock #DUUUVAL #FlyEaglesFly #RaiseHail

RB. Tier 1: Gibbs, Robinson. Tier 2: Taylor, McCaffrey, Cook. Gibbs had 164 scrimmage yards and 3 scores last week and draws the defense that has allowed the most points to backs. Start all five. #OnePride #DirtyBirds #ForTheShoe #FTTB #BillsMafia

RB, tier 2 continued: Jeanty, Brown. Tier 3 opens with Henry and Jaylen Warren, up eight spots: 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches with Dowdle out, who has not practiced this week. Start Warren as an RB1 Thursday. #RaiderNation #WhoDey #RavensFlock #HereWeGo

WR. Tier 1: Chase. Tier 2: St. Brown, Nacua (Q), Collins (Q). Nacua needs a full practice Wednesday; Collins has not practiced since the hamstring. Start Chase and St. Brown, and have a backup ready for the other two. #WhoDey #OnePride #RamsHouse #HTownMade

TE. Tier 1: McBride, Bowers, Warren. Bowers took 13 of 30 targets in his debut on 95 percent of the routes. The streamer: Tyler Higbee, 8 of 11 for 62 and a score with Terrance Ferguson likely out. Stream Higbee. #BirdGang #RaiderNation #ForTheShoe #RamsHouse

Specials. Aaron Jones Sr., 78 percent of Minnesota's carries vs the defense giving up the most to backs: start as an RB2. Chuba Hubbard, 20 carries and every first-half snap: start as a flex. Josh Downs, targets 3, 9, 11: start as a WR3. #Skol #KeepPounding #ForTheShoe

Off the menu. Caleb Williams (hamstring, 3 to 4 weeks): pivot to Jared Goff. Baker Mayfield (thumb, 3-plus weeks): pivot to Sam Darnold. De'Von Achane (ACL, IR): pivot to Ollie Gordon II, 84 percent of the snaps after he left. #DaBears #OnePride #GoBucs #Seahawks #PhinsUp

Full menu, all tiers, updated Friday with the injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
